mapper.select: WITH binned AS ( SELECT LEAST( #{columns} - 1, GREATEST(0, FLOOR(((ne.lng - #{west}) / (#{east} - #{west})) * #{columns})::integer) ) AS x, LEAST( #{rows} - 1, GREATEST(0, FLOOR(((#{north} - ne.lat) / (#{north} - #{south})) * #{rows})::integer) ) AS y FROM network_elements ne WHERE ne.location && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326) AND ne.lng BETWEEN #{west} AND #{east} AND ne.lat BETWEEN #{south} AND #{north} AND (#{types}::text[] IS NULL OR ne.type = ANY(#{types}::text[])) AND (#{propFilter}::text IS NULL OR ne.properties @> #{propFilter}::jsonb) ) SELECT x, y, COUNT(*) AS count FROM binned GROUP BY x, y ORDER BY y, x
